# Royal Air Maroc

> > Morocco's national carrier connecting 80+ countries through OneWorld alliance partnerships with 1000+ routes.

Royal Air Maroc is the flag carrier of Morocco, offering comprehensive flight booking, holiday packages, and loyalty programs. The airline operates a global network through OneWorld partnerships and serves major hubs including Casablanca, Marrakech, and connections to Middle Eastern and European destinations.

## Key Topics

- Flight Booking
- Loyalty Program (SAFAR FLYER)
- Seat Selection
- Online Check-in
- Holiday Packages
- OneWorld Alliance
- FlexPay Financing
- Casablanca Hub
- Travel Destinations
- Booking Management
- Extra Luggage
- Travel Alerts
- Entry Requirements
- Airport Operations
- Passenger Updates

## Booking & Flight Services

- [Book a flight](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/booking/book-flight): Flight booking engine with search, payment methods, and loyalty rewards.
- [Booking](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/booking): Flight booking hub with check-in, payment options, and ancillary services.
- [Manage booking](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/booking/manage-booking): Booking management for meals, seats, class changes, and flight modifications.
- [Online Check-in](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/booking/online-check-in): Online check-in with boarding pass, seat selection, and airport procedures.
- [Select seat](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/booking/select-seat): Seat selection and pricing during Royal Air Maroc flight booking.
- [Add extra luggage](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/add-extra-luggage): Extra baggage services and pre-purchase options for Royal Air Maroc flights.

## Travel & Vacation Packages

- [RAM Holidays](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/holidays): All-in-one holiday packages combining flights and hotels to Morocco.
- [Global network](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/oneworld): OneWorld alliance partnerships providing 1000+ routes across 150 countries.

## Payment & Financing Options

- [Pay over time with FlexPay](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/book-now-pay-later/uplift): FlexPay installment financing for flexible flight booking payments.

## News & Updates

- [News](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en/information/news): Travel alerts, flight updates, and entry requirements for Royal Air Maroc passengers.

## Home & Overview

- [Royal Air Maroc Airlines](https://www.royalairmaroc.com/us-en): Royal Air Maroc homepage: 80+ countries, flights, loyalty program, and services.
